item.title: Dean Malenko's Daughter Marie Makes Pro Wrestling NOAH Debut in Japan
item.description: Dean Malenko's daughter Marie Malenko debuted for Pro Wrestling NOAH on February 2, 2026, competing in a three-way tag team match at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo.

item.title: America's Most Wanted Reunite, Capture ALW World Tag Team Championships
item.description: James Storm and Chris Harris reunited as America's Most Wanted on Feb 1, capturing the ALW World Tag Team Championships.

item.title: Young Bucks Reveal Scrapped 'Evil EVP' AEW Storyline
item.description: The Young Bucks revealed original plans for their 'Evil EVP' angle in AEW. Find out what jokes and segments were cut and what could have been.

item.title: Bella Twins Name Potential 'Total Divas' Reboot Cast
item.description: The Bella Twins reveal their dream cast for a Total Divas reboot, including WWE stars like Maxxine Dupri and Jade Cargill. See who else they want!

item.title: Hiromu Takahashi Departs NJPW After New Beginning in Osaka
item.description: Hiromu Takahashi, a cornerstone of NJPW's junior heavyweight division, will conclude his New Japan career at New Beginning in Osaka on February 11, 2026.

item.title: Paul Heyman Wants WWE 2K26 to Steal Players from Fortnite, Call of Duty
item.description: Paul Heyman reveals WWE 2K26's ambitious goal isn't just wrestling fans - it's competing with Fortnite and Call of Duty for the gaming audience.

item.title: Je'Von Evans Says Randy Orton Match Changed Everything for His WWE Career
item.description: Je'Von Evans credits his breakthrough match against Randy Orton as the moment that transformed his WWE career and boosted his main roster confidence.

item.title: Oba Femi Destroys War Raiders, Remains WWE Free Agent
item.description: Oba Femi disrupted The War Raiders' match on WWE Raw, continuing his free agent storyline with management seeking to sign him.

item.title: Rey Mysterio Injured at Royal Rumble, Details From Raw
item.description: Michael Cole announced Rey Mysterio suffered injuries at WWE Royal Rumble, casting uncertainty on his immediate wrestling future after entering at number four.

item.title: Roman Reigns Selects CM Punk for WrestleMania 42 Showdown
item.description: Roman Reigns selected CM Punk as his WrestleMania 42 opponent on Raw, setting up a World Heavyweight Championship match over a decade in the making.
